title: CloudFoxable
description: A gamified cloud hacking sandbox by Bishop Fox, deployed into your own AWS account: twelve challenges (secrets in SSM and Secrets Manager, Lambda function URLs, SNS and SQS, role trusts, CloudFormation, privilege escalation paths) found and exploited from a starting IAM user, with CloudFox and the AWS CLI.
question: Starting as ctf-starting-user, find and capture the flags of the deployed challenges.
